mechanism: Ginseng may inhibit CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing ciprofloxacin levels; additionally, ginseng has anticoagulant properties that may potentiate bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for increased ciprofloxacin adverse effects (QT prolongation, tendinopathy, CNS effects) and counsel patients on bleeding precautions; consider spacing administration or selecting alternative antimicrobial if patient requires high-dose ginseng.
